provenance: 2026-07-24 18:22 outage lore. The canonical rule: never pair a pressure-GENERATING throttle (MemoryHigh) with a pressure-TRIGGERED killer (systemd-oomd ManagedOOMMemoryPressure) on the same cgroup tree. Recovery/design answer: keep MemoryMax (kernel kills the worst PROCESS inside the slice) and drop MemoryHigh; oomd kills a whole SCOPE.
